article_notes: Experimental B. rossi infection of 5 beagles (2 low, 3 high inoculum); one high-inoculum dog died on day 4. Authors state clinical severity was proportional to inoculum, but no severity groups are defined and all clinical/laboratory values are shown only in figures per individual; transcriptomic comparisons are day N vs day 0. Nothing extractable against severity.

not_extracted.what: Clinical and laboratory parameters (haematology, acid-base, lactate, glucose, cortisol, T4, CRP, cytokines) by inoculum dose, which the authors link to severity
not_extracted.note: Figs 1 and 2; inoculum dose is not a severity definition and n=2 vs 3
